provenance.label: CURATED EXAMPLE · DEVELOPMENT FALLBACK
provenance.description: Bundled explanatory example; this is not execution evidence or live telemetry.

events.title: “I worked Saturday.”
events.summary: The case records Ravi’s statement. A claim alone creates no authority.

inspector.authority_grant: None — claimant statements are not justification variants
inspector.disclosure: Ravi’s own statement enters the transcript; it does not establish the fact.
inspector.model_interpretation: Not in cloud replay — the claim is replayed
inspector.provenance_note: The deployed cloud hero replays this prior claim; it does not pretend the Worker Agent ran in that job.

events.title: Three propositions are required
events.summary: The planner derives the narrow facts needed under the pinned policy.

inspector.authority_grant: Policy-pinned planning only; no source access
inspector.disclosure: A request for propositions and permitted source classes — not raw evidence.
inspector.provenance_note: The frontend renders this plan from the case read model and does not derive policy requirements.

events.title: Raw source access refused
events.summary: The Control Plane identity was denied access to Site-A raw evidence by GCP IAM; the Site Agent identity was allowed.

inspector.authority_grant: GCP IAM denied the Control Plane identity storage.objects.get on Site-A raw evidence
inspector.disclosure: Observed HTTP 403: GCP IAM refused the Control Plane request for Site-A raw evidence.
inspector.model_interpretation: No model client in the Control Plane
inspector.deterministic_decision: No — GCP IAM enforces the boundary
inspector.provenance_note: Explanatory example only. The preferred path supplies this status from a captured execution artifact.

events.title: scheduled(RAVI, SAT) = true
events.summary: Gemini interprets employer-controlled payroll material through a call the Employer Agent makes.

inspector.disclosure: Only the scheduled relation returns to the Control Plane; the payroll material itself does not.
inspector.model_interpretation: Yes — Gemini 3.7 Flash, called by the Employer Agent
inspector.deterministic_decision: No — the agent interprets and attests
inspector.provenance_note: Source identity and cloud key reference follow the existing Milestone-F deployment contract.

events.title: Presence and duration threshold attested
events.summary: The Site Agent reads private site evidence and returns two narrow signed relations.

inspector.disclosure: Presence and a sufficient lower bound return. Exact minutes and raw logs do not.
inspector.model_interpretation: Yes — Gemini 3.7 Flash, called by the Site Agent
inspector.deterministic_decision: No — the agent interprets and attests
inspector.provenance_note: The agent has source-local access; the Control Plane receives relations, never the gate log or attendance image.

events.title: Authorized facts entail one outcome
events.summary: Exact duration remains unknown, but every policy-consistent world yields the same action.

inspector.disclosure: The certificate exposes the outcome and unresolved references, not source material.
inspector.model_interpretation: No — models cannot decide or authorize
inspector.provenance_note: The UI receives the computed result; it does not recompute policy semantics.

events.title: PAY Ravi ₹5,100
events.summary: The action is ready for a future authorization gate. No payment has been sent.

inspector.authority_grant: None to execute — Action Gate is not implemented
inspector.disclosure: A proposed consequential action, explicitly not a settlement receipt.
inspector.provenance_note: MUSTER has not decided that Ravi worked; it established payability under the pinned policy on attested grounds.
